# Contract — Eval Findings Fixes
*Generated by spec-writer. Regenerate on scope changes instead of hand-editing.*

## Definition of Done

Pipeline:
- [ ] `CityQuestSchema` has `loreReveal`, required for `TALK_TO_NPC` and forbidden for `KILL_MONSTER`
- [ ] Domain rule tested with plain objects, no mocks (AGENTS.md)
- [ ] Guardrails scan `loreReveal`
- [ ] One `CONTENT_LANGUAGE_INSTRUCTION`, used by Story, Dev and `GenerateShopInventorySkill`; no prompt restates it
- [ ] Story prompt describes `loreReveal`
- [ ] `schemas/content-package.schema.json` regenerated (`npm run build:schema`)
- [ ] Every phase written test-first, one commit per phase

Evals:
- [ ] `:talk-quests` case includes giver, target, and `loreReveal`
- [ ] Metric steps cover giver ≠ target and companion NPCs outside the roster
- [ ] `evals/README.md` updated
- [ ] New validation city added to `goldens.json`

## Acceptance Criteria

| # | Side | Given | When | Then | Covered by |
|---|------|-------|------|------|------------|
| AC1 | Pipeline | a `TALK_TO_NPC` quest with no `loreReveal` (or an empty one) | `CityQuestSchema` parses it | parsing fails and the issue names the quest id | `src/domain/value-objects/city-template.value-object.test.ts` |
| AC2 | Pipeline | a `KILL_MONSTER` quest with a `loreReveal` | `CityQuestSchema` parses it | parsing fails | `src/domain/value-objects/city-template.value-object.test.ts` |
| AC3 | Pipeline | valid quests of both types | `StoryManifestSchema` parses the fixture city | it passes, and the existing suites stay green | `src/domain/value-objects/city-template.value-object.test.ts`, `src/domain/entities/content-package.entity.test.ts` |
| AC4 | Pipeline | a story whose `loreReveal` contains "ignore all previous instructions" | `ApplyContentGuardrailsUseCase` runs | it throws `ContentGuardrailViolationError` | `src/application/use-cases/apply-content-guardrails.use-case.test.ts` |
| AC5 | Pipeline | the Story, Dev, and shop-skill agents | each sends its request | the system prompt contains `CONTENT_LANGUAGE_INSTRUCTION` | `openrouter-story-agent.test.ts`, `openrouter-dev-agent.test.ts`, `generate-shop-inventory.skill.test.ts` |
| AC6 | Pipeline | the Story agent | it sends its request | the system prompt's `TALK_TO_NPC` instruction asks for `loreReveal` | `src/infrastructure/agents/openrouter-story-agent.test.ts` |
| AC7 | Evals | the two existing manifests | `npm run eval` runs twice | no Aethelgard `:talk-quests` reason cites a giver/narrative mismatch, and no Necrópolis `:coherence` reason cites Zafira or Rami | `manual: read reasons in evals/results/*.json (plan Phase 5)` |
| AC8 | Evals | a city generated after Phases 1–4, with free models only | `npm run eval -- <cityId>` runs twice | `:language` ≥ 0.8 and `:talk-quests` ≥ 0.7 on both runs | `manual: plan Phase 6` |

## Quality Gates

Pipeline: `npm test`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build:schema` with the diff committed.
Evals: `npm run eval` (repo root). Judge and generation models must be `:free`; `evals/judge.py` enforces this for the judge.
